title: Find Documents by Words
description: A catalog needs documents containing both 'redis' and 'caching', with text relevance rather than a substring scan. Which structure directly supports matching?

options.text: A B-tree on the entire unprocessed description.
options.explanation: A normal B-tree orders full values; it does not map arbitrary words inside them to document IDs.

options.text: An inverted index from analyzed terms to postings lists.
options.explanation: Intersecting term postings finds documents containing both terms. Compatible analysis at indexing and query time handles case and stemming; ranking can then order matches.

options.text: A queue containing the latest catalog write.
options.explanation: A queue transports work but does not provide term-to-document retrieval.

options.text: A leading-wildcard LIKE query without a suitable text index.
options.explanation: That requires scanning values and lacks the requested linguistic analysis and relevance model.
